description: Earthquake impact and hazard products: Iran is a series of data sets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by WFP Automated Disaster Analysis & Mapping. ADAM ID: sm\us6000qy6g Magnitude 5.4 earthquake at 56.726 depth occurred on Aug 05 2025 70km S of Mohammadabad-E Rigan. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 28.0285 longitude 59.0845. It impacted 37403 people within 50km. Coverage: Iran. The portal lists 2 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher WFP Automated Disaster Analysis & Mapping. Its tags are affected population, earthquake-tsunami, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON. The portal shows 2026-05-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard and risk assessment. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
